name: Variance-Based Color Table Filtering
aliases: Variance-Based Color Table Filtering (Lagae et al.)
definition: A method by Lagae et al. to achieve accurate filtering for color table-based textures by estimating the noise value range δ from the loss in noise variance due to filtering.
summary: Variance-Based Color Table Filtering accurately filters textures by estimating noise ranges from variance loss, distinguishing itself by using analytical variance expressions instead of affine arithmetic.
